editorial.blurb: S&G is a beloved diner serving classic American comfort food with Greek touches, known for generous portions and genuinely warm hospitality.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive for breakfast to experience their legendary skillets packed with ingredients, or go at lunch when the wait is shorter but quality never dips.

well-seasoned meat and fresh veggies, comes with soup and side
